title: Task
description: Envelope schema for a `create_task`. A Task is a one-shot goal the scheduler picks up on the next tick and expands via goal_to_steps (cadence words in the goal are inert — recurrence needs a ScheduledTask). `create_task` already parses a typed CreateTaskInput, so serde enforces types; this schema documents the contract and adds min-length. A Task with `success_criteria` gets evaluator + adversarial steps appended/prepended automatically.

goal.description: The objective, in plain language. A routing prefix (e.g. `watch video:`, `fill knowledge gap:`, `run agent:`) selects the chain.

context.description: Extra background handed to the executing chain. Prior-failure context is injected here on a re-created task.

success_criteria.description: Measurable definition of done. Its presence turns on the generator-evaluator + adversarial-critic loops for this task.
